SELECT t.id
GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY MIN(stop_from.day_offset), MIN(stop_from.departure_time), t.id LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT DISTINCT stop_from.station_id AS from_station_id, stop_to.station_id AS to_station_id FROM train t INNER JOIN train_stop stop_from ON stop_from.train_id = t.id INNER JOIN train_stop stop_to ON stop_to.train_id = t.id AND stop_from.stop_order < stop_to.stop_order WHERE t.status = 1 ORDER BY from_station_id, to_station_id LIMIT #{limit}
